test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He _________ a long distance
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb **"ran"** is the **simple past tense of "run."**
 
• The other options** ("running," "runned," "run") **are not correct in this context.
 
• **"Running" is a gerund or present participle, "runned" is not a correct form, and "run" is the base form or past participle.**
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

**Correct Sentence:** *"He** ran** a long distance."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "running"** – This is the gerund or present participle form and does not fit the past tense context.
 
• **Option 2: "runned"** – This is an incorrect form of the verb "run."
 
• **Option 4: "run"** – This is the base form or past participle, not the simple past tense.
